content.short: Unified liquidity layer letting DeFi apps on different chains share one pool of liquidity.
content.description: Euclid Protocol pools liquidity in one place and makes it reachable from many chains, so a DEX or app on a new network does not have to bootstrap its own. Its product suite includes Euclid Swap, a launchpad, a block explorer and Planet Euclid, a passport-based community programme. More than 1.2 million unique wallets used its testnet.
content.meta: Euclid Protocol gives DeFi apps on any chain access to one shared liquidity layer, with swaps, a launchpad and explorer.
